name: conf-mcp

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get full details of a Confluence page by its numeric content ID or by a pasted page URL (viewpage.action?pageId=..., /spaces/KEY/pages/ID/..., or /display/SPACE/Title)

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID, e.g. 123456, or a full page URL

body_format.description: Body representation: 'storage' (default, raw XHTML), 'view' (rendered HTML), or 'none' (metadata only)

body_limit.description: Max characters of body to return (default 40000)

body_start.description: Character offset to start the body slice from (default 0)

save_to.description: Absolute local file path to write the full body to (must not exist); the result then carries metadata only. Use for large pages you want to grep or read in parts

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new Confluence page. Pass Markdown with body_format='markdown' (converted server-side), or raw Confluence storage format (XHTML) with the default body_format='storage'

body.description: Page content. Markdown when body_format='markdown', else Confluence storage format (XHTML)

parent_page_id.description: Content ID of the parent page, if nesting under one

body_format.description: Format of the provided body: 'storage' (default, raw Confluence storage XHTML) or 'markdown' (Markdown, converted to storage server-side). Use 'storage' for Confluence macros (code, panel, expand, TOC) which Markdown cannot express.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update a Confluence page. This is a full replace and auto-increments the version. Pass Markdown with body_format='markdown' (converted server-side), or raw Confluence storage format (XHTML) with the default body_format='storage'; omit body/title to keep existing values

body.description: New page content. Markdown when body_format='markdown', else Confluence storage format; omit to keep existing content

title.description: New title; omit to keep existing title

body_format.description: Format of the provided body: 'storage' (default, raw Confluence storage XHTML) or 'markdown' (Markdown, converted to storage server-side). Use 'storage' for Confluence macros (code, panel, expand, TOC) which Markdown cannot express.

tools.name: patch_page
tools.description: Replace exact substrings in a Confluence page's storage-format body without resending the full body. Pass one old_string/new_string pair, or several in edits to change many spots in one version (applied in order; if any edit fails to match exactly once, nothing is written). Use for targeted edits to large pages where update_page's full-body replace is impractical.

old_string.description: Exact text to find in the current storage-format body; must be unique

edits.description: Several replacements applied in order as one page version; use instead of old_string/new_string

old_string.description: Exact text to find in the current storage-format body; must be unique

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Move a Confluence page to trash (recoverable). Does not permanently purge

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID to move to trash

tools.name: delete_pages
tools.description: Move several Confluence pages to trash (recoverable). Does not permanently purge. Pages are processed in order; a failure on one does not stop the rest, and the result lists each page's outcome

page_ids.description: Confluence page/content IDs to move to trash

tools.name: move_page
tools.description: Move a Confluence page (with its children) under a new parent page, including a parent in another space. Content and title are kept; the version increments

parent_id.description: ID of the page that becomes the new parent

tools.name: move_pages
tools.description: Move several Confluence pages (each with its children) under the same new parent page, including a parent in another space. Pages are processed in order; a failure on one does not stop the rest, and the result lists each page's outcome

parent_id.description: ID of the page that becomes the new parent

tools.name: get_page_by_title
tools.description: Get a Confluence page by its space key and exact title

title.description: Exact page title to look up

body_format.description: Body representation: 'storage' (default, raw XHTML), 'view' (rendered HTML), or 'none' (metadata only)

body_limit.description: Max characters of body to return (default 40000)

body_start.description: Character offset to start the body slice from (default 0)

save_to.description: Absolute local file path to write the full body to (must not exist); the result then carries metadata only. Use for large pages you want to grep or read in parts

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search Confluence content using CQL (Confluence Query Language)

cql.description: CQL query, e.g. 'type=page AND space=ENG AND title~"deploy"', or 'ancestor=123456' for every page under a page (parent=123456 for direct children only). Fields: space,title,type,text,label,creator,created,lastmodified,ancestor,parent. Operators: = != ~ !~ > >= < <= IN. Keywords: AND OR NOT ORDER BY

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List Confluence spaces, or fetch a single space by key

limit.description: Max results (ignored if space_key is set)

space_key.description: Exact space key to fetch a single space; omit to list all spaces

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Resolve a Confluence user's display name and profile from a userKey or username. Useful for turning a page's stored userkey (e.g. from a user mention/link) into a readable name.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Confluence page. Body must be Confluence storage format (XHTML), not Markdown

body.description: Comment content in Confluence storage format (XHTML), not Markdown

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID to comment on

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Get comments on a Confluence page, 50 per call. When the result has _links.next, call again with start increased by 50

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID to fetch comments for

tools.name: upload_attachment
tools.description: Attach a local file to a Confluence page. If an attachment with the same name exists, fails unless overwrite=true, which uploads it as a new version. Reference it in the body with <ac:image><ri:attachment ri:filename="..."/></ac:image> or an ac:link

file_name.description: Name to store the file under; defaults to the file's basename

file_path.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload

overwrite.description: Replace a same-name attachment with a new version (default false: fail instead)

page_id.description: Confluence page/content ID to attach to

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments of a Confluence page (name, size, media type, version, download link)

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Download a page attachment (latest version) to a local file. Fails if dest_path already exists

dest_path.description: Absolute local path to save to; must not already exist

filename.description: Exact attachment file name on the page
